decision_basis: Explicit Owner approval in the current conversation to proceed with the proposed bounded acceptance and retention policy.
limitations_accepted_and_preserved: The historical WP09 V1 tarball and any untracked raw members it may have contained remain unavailable; the accepted reconstruction contains only the 32 surviving Git-tracked files.
The four WP04-D reproduced NPZ paths match all recorded historical sizes and SHA-256 values, but original-file provenance is not recovered.
The bounded inventory does not certify all worktrees, disks, historical backups, or all campaign evidence.
One existing WP14 source archive remains anyone-with-link reader because current CI downloads it without authentication; its permission was not changed.
The Drive folder access snapshot does not attest account-wide connector OAuth scope, actual Google account quota, or independent backup redundancy.
